claims: The UConn Huskies men's basketball program has won six NCAA Division I National Championships (1999, 2004, 2011, 2014, 2023, 2024).
The UConn Huskies men's basketball program ranks tied for third all-time.
The UConn Huskies men's basketball program became the eighth team in NCAA history to win back-to-back titles in 2023 and 2024.
The UConn Huskies men's basketball program holds a 6-1 record in championship games.
In 1999, the UConn Huskies defeated Duke 77-74.
In 2004, the UConn Huskies defeated Georgia Tech 82-73.
In 2011, the UConn Huskies defeated Butler 53-41.
In 2014, the UConn Huskies defeated Kentucky 60-54.
In 2023, the UConn Huskies defeated San Diego State 76-59.
In 2024, the UConn Huskies defeated Purdue 75-60.
In 2026, the UConn Huskies lost to Michigan 69-63.
Until their loss to Michigan in the 2026 national championship, the UConn Huskies had a perfect 6-0 record in title games.
Dan Hurley led the team to titles in 2023 and 2024.
The UConn women's team has won a record 12 NCAA championships.
UConn has won the Big East Tournament title 8 times (combined history).
UConn won the American Athletic Conference tournament once in 2016.
